subject: Re: [External Sender] Re: Encord/Capital One follow Up
text:
Hey Alex,

Looking forward to syncing this afternoon.  Here are our open
issues/questions:

   1. We need access to
   https://github.com/encord-team/encord-capital-one-collab
   2. "Encord's default storage uses (and REQUIRES) Google Cloud Storage.
   You do not need to use this GCP bucket but you MUST create one. For content
   storage, you can use your existing AWS buckets using a cloud integration."
   - This is going to be painful for us from a process and approval
      perspective.  Can you do the dev work to make this not required
at install
      time since it's not required at runtime.
   3. "Managed ClickHouse Instance"
      - Can you provide more details on the ownership of this.  Is this a
      SaaS service?  Do we have a self deploy options?
   4. "ACM certificates (for SSL/TLS)"
      1. Can you elaborate on the requirement here?  This may be covered by
      our existing K8s cluster features.
   5. "IAM roles and policies (for resource access and permissions)"
      - Can you provide the detailed roles and policies we'll need?
   6. "Zitadel Authentication"
      - Can you provide details on your SSO integration support?

Thanks,
Jeff

subject: Re: Use Cases & Success Criteria
text:
Hi Steffan

Encord Annotate

   -

   Native Video action recognition
   -

   Putting timestamps on labels the timeline of the video - *isn't this the
   action recognition?*
   -

      E.g walking, passing, standing,
      -

   Text field annotation options for subtitling - *Don't worry about this. *
   -

   Segmentation, oriented bounding box - *mainly obb. segmentation would be
   a nice to try*
   -

   Audio annotation capabilities
   -

   Annotate video and audio separately and also together *- combination is
   not necessary for now. our video's don't have an audio track for the
   moment. *

Encord Active

   -

   Identify edge cases to feed into annotation workflow
   -

   Visualize the distribution of labels
   -

   What other use cases would you like to test - *I think you listed the
   most important ones. Having a system that easily allows us to analyze how
   well a model performs is the most important here. That means detecting
   failure cases and also being able to see that we don't have drift between
   our datasets*

Encord Index

   -

   You mentioned during our pricing call that this may not be of as much
   interest, but are there certain use cases you would like to try?

*We have an internal tool that almost looks identical to Index, maybe you
can put it in such that I can show it to our CTO. Maybe he'll like it? But
don't think we'll need it.*

Kind regards,
Frederik
